0022600033.text: The Sacramento Kings (1-7, 0-3 at home) host the San Antonio Spurs (6-2, winners of six straight) in their ninth game of the season, with the Kings on a one-game losing streak and sitting 15th in the West. The Kings are missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), De'Andre Hunter (illness), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), while the Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf strain). The Kings trail the season series 0-1 after losing 130-103 in San Antonio on October 27, 2026, and they lost all three meetings with the Spurs in 2025-26.
